title: Inflation Rate Holds at 3.4% in August, Bolsters Rate Hike Wagers (UPDATED)
summary: U.S. annual inflation held at 3.4% in August, matching the market consensus and remaining unchanged from July, the Bureau of Labor Statistics said Friday.
